name: Selesnya Conclave
description: The Selesnya Conclave is a green-white Ravnican guild of nature and unity, a decentralized collective founded by Mat'Selesnya with Vitu-Ghazi as its guildhall.

bio.text: In Return to Ravnica Trostani's influence grew within the Conclave, Emmara Tandris was chosen as its champion, and other guilds such as the Orzhov grew wary of its preparations.

bio.text: Its missionaries met scorn and martyrdom in the Shanav Quarter, while its sentries held off a Gruul clan at the Battle of Sumala.

Selesnya Sentry (Return to Ravnica, 2012), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

"Rage of the Unsung" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jan 2019.

timeline.summary: Niszka calls for pruning Ravnica into verdant uniformity.
timeline.quote: Ravnica, like a hedge, must be pruned, leaving only leaves of verdant uniformity.

citation.text: Hour of Reckoning (Ravnica: City of Guilds, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Savra tries to infiltrate the Selesnya Conclave but is double-crossed by Szadek, who snaps her neck.
timeline.quote: she was double-crossed by Szadek, who snapped her neck to weaken the Conclave.

citation.text: "Golgari Swarm", section "Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Szadek manipulates Savra and the Selesnya Conclave into killing Mat'Selesnya.
timeline.quote: manipulating Savra and the Selesnya Conclave to do his bidding and kill Mat'Selesnya

citation.text: "House Dimir", section "Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the Decamillennial the Selesnya lose their connection to the World Tree and rely on a high council; Mat'Selesnya goes dormant within Vitu-Ghazi and Suniel helps three dryads fuse into Trostani.
timeline.quote: Suniel helped three Dryad sisters to fuse into Trostani to function as the direct voice of Mat'Selesnya and as the new guildmaster.

citation.text: "Selesnya Conclave", section "Leadership". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The three dryads materialize in Vitu-Ghazi as Trostani, the new guildmaster, and Suniel realizes Cim is gone.
timeline.quote: The three who are one told the high priests that they were now Trostani

citation.text: "Suniel", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Selesnya are lynched en masse during the events of Agents of Artifice for their role in oppressing the guilds, but later return.
timeline.quote: the Selesnya were lynched en masse due to the citizens realizing their role in forcing the oppression of the guilds.

citation.text: "Selesnya Conclave", section "Conflict and redemption". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the Guildpact's dissolution riots, Emmara survives as a healer in Ovitzia and befriends the young telepath Berrim.
timeline.quote: she met a young telepath named Berrim

citation.text: "Emmara Tandris", section "Agents of Artifice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Parhelion reappears on a collision course with Prahv as the Azorius, Boros and Selesnya become embroiled in a scandal over Feather, who turned herself in.
timeline.quote: The Dissension began with the dramatic reappearance of the Parhelion

citation.text: "The Dissension", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teysa warns Isperia that the Selesnya are gathering armies.
timeline.quote: The Selesnya are gathering armies.

citation.text: Horncaller's Chant (Return to Ravnica, 2012), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Four Selesnya sentries held off an entire Gruul clan at the Battle of Sumala.
timeline.quote: four Selesnya sentries held off an entire clan of Gruul warriors.

citation.text: Selesnya Sentry (Return to Ravnica, 2012), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Selesnya missionaries in the Shanav Quarter faced scorn and martyrdom.
timeline.quote: they faced scorn, ridicule, and ultimately martyrdom.

citation.text: Assassin's Strike (Return to Ravnica, 2012), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ruzi resolves to break from Selesnya and make destroying Massacre Girl his purpose, knowing Trostani would not permit vengeance.
timeline.quote: If justice was to be done, Ruzi must break from Selesnya and find another way.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: The Selesnya high priests meet as the guild fades; Molander proposes an academy to keep the guild alive.
timeline.quote: Selesnya must go on with or without our parun , Mat'Selesnya.

citation.text: "The Great Concourse". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Oct 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The three dryads appear grown from the World Tree in the great hall of Vitu-Ghazi as the new guildmaster, and Suniel realizes the Cim he knew is no more.
timeline.quote: Little did they know that they would gaze upon their new guildmaster for the first time.

citation.text: "The Great Concourse". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Oct 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Durri tells Kal that the Selesnyan healer's camp was massacred, reportedly by the Rakdos.
timeline.quote: Ogreth said it was the Rakdos.

citation.text: "Gruul Ingenuity". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Dec 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Emmara Tandris was chosen as Selesnya's champion.
timeline.quote: When Selesnya needed a champion, Emmara put the ranks of her guild before herself

citation.text: Emmara Tandris (Dragon's Maze, 2013), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Trostani's influence grew, spreading vitality through the Conclave to the dismay of other guilds.
timeline.quote: As Trostani's influence grew, vitality spread through the Conclave

citation.text: Unflinching Courage (Dragon's Maze, 2013), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Selesnya missionaries moved into the Shanav Quarter and faced scorn, ridicule, and martyrdom.
timeline.quote: When Selesnya missionaries moved into the Shanav Quarter, they faced scorn, ridicule, and ultimately martyrdom.

citation.text: Assassin's Strike (Battlebond, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Arrus discovers that trees on the Selesnyan border are only five years old, planted as a fast-grown barrier that leeches magic from the Rubblebelt.
timeline.quote: Selesnya had planted thousands and thousands of saplings, and then accelerated their growth until they had the perfect impenetrable barrier.

citation.text: "Rage of the Unsung" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jan 2019.

timeline.summary: Ruric and Thar accept Arrus's challenge, set themselves alight and declare war on Selesnya.
timeline.quote: If Selesnya wants a war, we'll give them a war,

citation.text: "Rage of the Unsung" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jan 2019.

timeline.summary: Miri's father comes home with a thrull-replaced leg after a failed scheme involving an Izzet machine and wurms, and curses Selesnya.
timeline.quote: Father cursed the Selesnya Conclave

citation.text: "The Ledger of Hidden Fortunes" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Feb 2019.

timeline.summary: Miri joins the Selesnyan initiates and befriends Danika, Caz and Vasil.
timeline.quote: Danika, Caz, and Vasil are in my assigned developmental pod.

citation.text: "The Ledger of Hidden Fortunes" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Feb 2019.

timeline.summary: Selesnya agrees to help after Trostani awakens and overrules Emmara Tandris.
timeline.quote: her decision was overruled when Trostani awakened and ruled in favor of helping the Gatewatch

citation.text: "Araithia Shokta", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The group finds the Selesnya Conclave fortified and hostile, with Nissa blamed for awakening Vitu-Ghazi.
timeline.quote: We found the Conclave well and truly fortified. And unwelcoming.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Rat slips inside and meets her godfather Boruvo, who is moved to help.
timeline.quote: my godfather, Keeper of my Life Pledge, the Selesnyan spearmaster Boruvo

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Boruvo carries Rat to her friends and through the Ledev line, and demands that Nissa be sent away; Nissa leaves to join Gideon.
timeline.quote: I've never been very good at talking. You two go with the centaur. I'll join Gideon.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Kaya realizes Rat is invisible to Nissa and nearly everyone, and Rat explains that she is insignificant by birth magic.
timeline.quote: I'm not invisible. I'm insignificant . A rat.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Emmara Tandris meets Kaya in the presence of the dormant dryad Trostani, and refuses to commit Selesnya because Ral's plans have been disasters.
timeline.quote: So far, every one has been an unmitigated disaster for the guilds, for Ravnica, and especially for Selesnya.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Kaya tells Emmara the plan is called Operation Desperation and argues Bolas must be defeated.
timeline.quote: Operation Desperation.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Mistress Cim awakes and persuades Mistress Ses to restore Trostani's harmony, and Selesnya joins the other guilds against Bolas.
timeline.quote: It is the will of Mat'Selesnya that the Conclave join the other guilds to defeat Nicol Bolas.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: After the Invasion the Conclave closes in on itself and refuses all aid and offers to help others.
timeline.quote: Immediately following the end of the Invasion, the Conclave closed in on itself, shutting itself off to outsiders.

citation.text: "Selesnya Conclave", section "Phyrexian invasion and aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vraska's forces transform her subjects and defeat Selesnyan warriors in the undercity.
timeline.quote: a cohort of Selesnyan warriors tear through a hole in the maze

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Proft reveals the killer must be a member of the Selesnya Conclave.
timeline.quote: This is a creation of the Conclave. Our killer is a member of the Selesnya.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 8: Gods of Chaos
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 8: Gods of Chaos" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Teysa explains she will ruin Selesnya financially rather than use the law, and asks Kaya to leave Ravnica.
timeline.quote: You'll have to leave, of course.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: The Conclave's falcons scout Vitu-Ghazi, New Prahv and Orzhova.
timeline.quote: Soaring over Vitu-Ghazi, New Prahv, and Orzhova, the Conclave's trained falcons provided critical intelligence.

citation.text: War Screecher (Ravnica: Clue Edition, 2024), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Arrus learns of the Selesnya Conclave's scheme to drain the Rubblebelt's magic.
timeline.quote: Selesnya Conclave's insidious scheme to drain the Rubblebelt's magic

citation.text: "Arrus", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arrus and Baas journey into Selesnyan territory for ingredients for her healing ink.
timeline.quote: They ventured into Selesnyan territory in search of ingredients for Baas's special ink

citation.text: "Baas", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arrus discovers Selesnya's secret project to build a barrier between the Rubblebelt and Selesnyan territory, fueling his resolve to challenge his clan's leadership.
timeline.quote: Arrus discovered Selesnya's secret project

citation.text: "Baas", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Cecilee builds a vernadi in the Rubblebelt as a healing center and forms a bond with the Gruul.
timeline.quote: she built an outpost of the Conclave called a vernadi

citation.text: "Cecilee", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Schism mutates the plague into an airborne plague wind; the guilds respond.
timeline.quote: mutating it to become airborne

citation.text: "Creation of the Schism", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The guilds fight internally over whether to follow Bolas's influence; in the end five fall under his influence and five do not.
timeline.quote: In the end, five fall under his influence, and five don't.

citation.text: "Guilds of Ravnica block", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Massacre Girl leads a Rakdos massacre of a nearby Selesnyan vernadi.
timeline.quote: Massacre Girl led a Rakdos massacre of a Selesnyan vernadi nearby

citation.text: "Janik", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Twelve ancient dryads merge into Mat'Selesnya, sacrificing their identities for lasting peace.
timeline.quote: who had sacrificed their identities and their freedom ten thousand years ago

citation.text: "Mat'Selesnya", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Danika swapped plants with Miri so she could succeed at the growth spell.
timeline.quote: Danika's selfless act of swapping their plants

citation.text: "Miri", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nikya diplomatically asks Cecilee for the Gruul infant back; Cecilee refuses and Nikya severs ties with the Selesnyans.
timeline.quote: Cecilee refused to give up the infant

citation.text: "Nikya", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Borca's ghost tells Kos he must avenge him; Kos and Feather find Fonn and Jarad at Pivlic's arena restaurant and ally against attacking Selesnya quietmen.
timeline.quote: they form an alliance when Selesnya quietmen attack the arena

citation.text: "Ravnica (novel)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Savra places Bayul's stone on her forehead to join the conclave, and Szadek snaps her neck.
timeline.quote: Szadek snaps her neck

citation.text: "Ravnica (novel)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arrus convinces Ruric Thar to attack the Selesnya.
timeline.quote: he convinced Ruric Thar to attack the Selesnya

citation.text: "Ruric Thar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
